scripts.build: npm run build -w @pyle/shared && npm run build -w @pyle/control-plane -w @pyle/gateway
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware apps/ packages/ test/ scripts/ && eslint .
scripts.test:cov:all: npm run test:cov:unit && npm run test:cov:feature && npm run test:cov:e2e && npm run test:cov:merge
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/run-with-env.sh prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/control-plane
scripts.db:migration:new: bash scripts/run-with-env.sh prisma migrate dev --create-only --schema prisma/control-plane
scripts.admin:create: npm run build && bash scripts/run-with-env.sh node apps/control-plane/dist/auth/cli/create-admin-user.js
scripts.seed: npm run build && bash scripts/run-with-env.sh node apps/control-plane/dist/seed/main.js
scripts.seed:clean: npm run build && bash scripts/run-with-env.sh node apps/control-plane/dist/seed/main.js clean
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build && bash scripts/run-with-env.sh node apps/control-plane/dist/seed/main.js admin
scripts.admin:create: npm run build && bash scripts/run-with-env.sh node apps/control-plane/dist/auth/cli/create-admin-user.js
scripts.bench: npm run build -w @pyle/shared && npm run build -w @pyle/gateway && tsx --conditions=source scripts/bench.ts
